summary: Keep qnetd's package NSS path redirected to runtime-only CA storage

guide.reason: This is development feasibility evidence, not an operator workflow or available product feature.

api.reason: Packaging redirects Debian's existing qnetd files to tmpfs and adds no Controller/Core route or API behavior; authenticated witness registration remains a separate slice.

roadmap.reason: The approved native qnetd CA design remains planned; this evidence does not change milestone status or acceptance gates.

state.reason: All certificates and NSS databases were disposable test data under the ephemeral container's /run; no product state was added.

verification.method: Debian 13 corosync-qnetd 3.0.3-2 in ephemeral containers: direct native NSS runtime initialization/signing and qnetd loading were exercised; package lifecycle was exercised with dpkg-reconfigure, persistent /etc-to-/run symlink, systemd-tmpfiles recreation after simulated /run loss, stable CA fingerprint on configure, and changed fingerprint after runtime reset. The appliance runtime initializer and qnetd daemon command were exercised, NSS ownership/modes inspected. systemd-analyze verify reported `Command man corosync-qnetd failed`, so unit verification is incomplete. Focused packaging test, docs gate and repository privacy test passed. No reboot or actual systemd service startup was tested.
